newsitem.title: USA: ANR accepts firm gas storage requests.
newsitem.headline: ANR accepts firm gas storage requests.

text.p: Coastal Corp's ANR Pipeline Co said Thursday it has begun accepting offers for its firm natural gas storage service for the injection season that starts April 1.
The open season is effective immediately and will continue until 1700 EST March 14, the company said in a statement.

The eastern leg of ANR Pipeline runs from offshore Louisiana to Michigan, while the western leg begins in Oklahoma and runs into Michigan and Wisconsin and interconnects with the Great Lakes pipeline.
